notes: The menu is sized from the window instead of a fixed 260px column - width and button height scale with the panel, with floors so nothing clips - and it now has the same feel as the rest of the UI: the rows settle in on entrance like a page switch, buttons lean toward the cursor, a press leaves a ripple, and hover/tap play the interface sounds. The buttons were also being drawn above the wordmark because their container had no LayoutOrder. The first version drew a small centred card and left the sidebar visible beside it, which was not what a main menu is. The loading bar completes, the panel does not appear on its own any more: a card takes its place with the wordmark, the build and rev, and Enter / Settings / Credits. Enter fades the hub in. Settings is a shortcut into the real Settings tab, not a second copy, so the tab list is unchanged once you are in. Credits resolves 1562524075 when the menu is built - display name and user name from the Players API, with the in-game player and a name lookup as fallbacks if the batch call is unavailable - so the card never shows a stale hardcoded name. The menu holds the window back rather than racing the reveal: it waits for loadingDone, hides the window and shadow, and restores both exactly where the reveal left them.
